arena_context_desc: sharp top-down view over a smooth pitch-black obsidian abyss
static_hold_desc: smooth pitch-black obsidian abyss without movement
negative_desc: gravel, sand, dirt, brown mud, blurry, noisy, text, watermark, box, cage, wireframe

e0_s0.essence_desc: a pulsing electric-blue crystalline spearhead core
e0_s0.action_desc: projects a piercing cyan kinetic laser wave across the obsidian void

e0_s1.essence_desc: a spinning cobalt-blue multi-bladed plasma turbine
e0_s1.action_desc: whirls at supersonic speed, generating shockwave ripples across the floor

e0_s2.essence_desc: a radiant sapphire lightning crown with branching arcs
e0_s2.action_desc: discharges forked blue lightning bolts into the adjacent structure

e1_s0.essence_desc: a radiant emerald-green spiral vortex archway
e1_s0.action_desc: pulls surrounding light inward and synthesizes a glowing green nova

e1_s1.essence_desc: a blooming bioluminescent jade-green crystalline lotus
e1_s1.action_desc: unfurls glowing emerald petals that engulf and transmute the target

e1_s2.essence_desc: a blazing viridian-green miniature plasma sun
e1_s2.action_desc: erupts with concentric emerald solar flares across the obsidian arena

e2_s0.essence_desc: a towering dark-violet obsidian monolith prism
e2_s0.action_desc: deflects incoming trajectories and refracts them into golden rays

e2_s1.essence_desc: a geometric array of floating amethyst crystal mirrors
e2_s1.action_desc: folds space and reflects golden-magenta beams onto the star creature

e2_s2.action_desc: expands geometric forcefields that reshape the approaching star into gold

e3_s3.essence_desc: a crisp articulated bioluminescent blue five-limbed starfish creature
e3_s3.action_desc: crawls rapidly forward across the pitch-black obsidian abyss with agile limbs

e3_s4.essence_desc: a glowing golden-cyan multi-tentacled star creature with extended feelers
e3_s4.action_desc: glides smoothly in a wide arc, extending radiant golden limbs

e3_s5.essence_desc: a blazing crimson-and-gold crystalline nova star creature
e3_s5.action_desc: pulsates with blinding ruby-gold shockwaves that shatter blue crystals

quest.ongoing_hypothesis: the star creature is approaching the violet-magenta crystal structure in the dark void
quest.completed_hypothesis: the star creature ignites with golden-crimson tentacles as the crystal structure refracts light into it

quest.ongoing_hypothesis: the blue crystalline core is stationary before the radiant golden-crimson star
quest.completed_hypothesis: the golden-crimson star energizes the blue core, transforming it into a whirling cobalt plasma turbine with lightning arcs

quest.ongoing_hypothesis: the emerald vortex is dim beside the electric-blue turbine
quest.completed_hypothesis: piercing blue lightning from the turbine ignites the emerald structure into a blooming jade lotus and blazing green sun

quest.ongoing_hypothesis: the dark violet monolith stands rigid before the blazing emerald lotus
quest.completed_hypothesis: emerald plasma waves engulf the monolith and recrystallize it into floating amethyst mirrors and magenta-gold forcefields
